findings.title: Filter by workflow also matches item rows
findings.detail:
rowText adds the story's workflow for item rows too, so `/quick` keeps NEEDS YOU items of quick stories as well as story rows. The issue says only 'Filtering matches the workflow name'; this reading is consistent and arguably useful.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: None needed; mention if a person wants story rows only.
